about: Crafty Shield stops Bestow, the one guard that does from the sixth generation (Pokemon Central, Cediregalo: it ignores every protection but Crafty Shield); Bestow's record has no protect flag, which let it through that one too. Nothing in New Gold learns the move, so the scenario teaches it: in the Violet Gym the player's Snorlax holds Leftovers and knows Bestow alone, Falkner's Hoothoot holds nothing and knows Crafty Shield alone (set:, teach:). The shield goes up first and the Bestow fails against it; each keeps what it had.

lines: The opposing Hoothoot used Crafty Shield!
